reason: The one-file source diff changes how PyVRP computes the proximity matrix used to construct local-search neighbourhoods. In-place accumulation replaces multiple temporary NumPy arrays without intentionally changing the search policy; end-to-end effect must still be measured because a changed neighbour ranking or initialization cost can alter fixed-budget search.
solver_behavior_hypothesis: Accumulating proximity components into one floating-point matrix may reduce neighbourhood-construction allocations and give the solver more useful search time within fixed budgets without changing selected neighbours.
causal_chain: Every neighbourhood build converts edge costs to floating point, subtracts prizes, then adds wait and time-warp penalties. Reusing the converted matrix removes intermediate arrays; if values or ties change, nearest-neighbour lists and downstream local-search trajectories may also change.
structural_trigger: CVRP instances with at least two clients that construct granular search neighbourhoods; larger matrices increase the temporary-allocation cost, while nonzero prizes or time-window penalties test arithmetic semantics.
activation_probe: Trace _compute_proximity and compute_neighbours on public CVRP cases in both pinned source states; compare proximity values and selected-neighbour lists, then verify every returned route on original instances.
instance_selection_rule: Use the existing fixed PyVRP CVRP development, hidden ID, and generated-shift panels with one predeclared private seed for baseline qualification; retain the full task seed and budget grid for Agent judging and do not select instances after reading the hidden PR effect.
workload_exposure_plan: Run the pinned base and source-only PR image through the shared PyVRP CVRP driver, record neighbourhood-path activation and independent route checks, and keep all failures and resource measurements.
mathematical_risk: In-place floating-point accumulation can change proximity ties, propagate a nonfinite value, or mutate a shared array; resulting search changes could produce an invalid route or objective.
independent_check_plan: Check original CVRP visit coverage, capacity, and objective for every solution; compare public proximity matrices and neighbour lists between source states, including degenerate ties and penalty-bearing cases.
hidden_generalization_plan: Report fixed-budget verified gap trajectories, missing runs, and per-instance regressions separately for hidden ID and generated-shift CVRP families; a positive human PR reference requires a separate paired confirmation.
overlap_review: The neighbourhood-array mechanism is separate from PR #966 trip materialization, #967 route loading, and #988 ILS policy. Inspect later neighbourhood PRs before assigning them distinct lineages.
resource_risk: The converted edge-cost matrix remains materialized; allocation savings may be too small to affect end-to-end solving, and NumPy in-place operations may change peak memory only during initialization.
